reason: I'd run the free 15-page plan on one site first, and if the captures come out clean I'd grab the $79 lifetime before the 100 spots go, because the 14-day refund covers me. I would never take the $9 a month plan; I'm not adding another subscription for something I only need now and then.
objection: I'm not pasting my clients' login sessions into a brand-new tool with no reviews, so the login-page feature is useless to me. And with lifetime deals, the company folding in a year is a real risk, which would make my $79 worthless.
would_change_my_mind: If the lifetime deal sold out or went away and only the monthly or yearly plans were left, I'd stay on the free tier and not buy.
